Keys                                                                                                   esc or ? to close
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  navigation                            account                              session
  j/↓          next row                 enter   switch to selected account   s         subshell, every active slot
  k/↑          previous row             d/i     details                      S         subshell, this account only
  g/home       first row                l       login                        r         run provider CLI command
  G/end        last row                 L       login every stale account    R         reload
  ctrl+f/pgdn  page down                c       create account               p         toggle detail pane
  ctrl+b/pgup  page up                  e       edit account                 z         fold or unfold provider group
  tab          next provider tab        ctrl+d  delete account               !         only rows needing action
  shift+tab    previous provider tab    a       save current ADC here        o         cycle name/status/expiry sort
  1-9          jump to tab (1 is All)   y       copy the env eval line       ?         help
  >            jump to linked account                                        q/ctrl+c  quit
  /            filter
  esc          clear applied filter
  :            command palette

  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
